days.title: Sant Llorenç Peaks and Caves
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: la Mola
stops.detail: Precipitation ranges between 800 mm annually at La Mola and 700 at Obac, concentrated during autumn and spring, although local storms can occur in summer and it can occasionally snow in winter.

stops.name: cueva Simanya
stops.detail: Among all of them, the one known as the Simanya cave stands out, which serves as drainage for Montcau: its entrance mouth is ten meters high, leading to a first gallery 100 meters long, then another of 110 and finally to two branches of 45 and 60 meters more respectively.

stops.name: cueva del Manel
stops.detail: Also significant are the Manel cave (with 932 m between the different galleries), the Ànimes cave (276 m) and the Daví chasm (65 m deep and 250 m long), all of them in Sant Llorenç del Munt.

days.title: Obac Range and Information
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: collado de Estenalles
stops.detail: Both mountain groups are separated in the south by the Arenas stream and to the north by the Estenalles torrent, joining through the Estenalles pass (870.4 m), where there is an information center.

stops.name: Cuevas o Mina de Mura
stops.detail: In the Obac mountain range, the Mura Caves or Mine should be mentioned, 180 m long and with a large room full of stalactites, stalagmites and rocks of curious shapes.
